name: Supplier & Margin
focus: EU sourcing, landed cost and supplier consolidation for 20–50 SKUs
summary: BigBuy remains the primary consolidation anchor, but a same-ecosystem reusable roller path is not viable: the public Rellair InnovaGoods listing is €11.89 and sold out, so it does not solve Muda Cero economics or stock. Hertwill is added as a WATCH secondary EU supplier channel: free tier up to 5 products, automated stock/fulfilment, no inventory/MOQ, neutral packaging, EU delivery in 3–8 business days, Spain standard-parcel shipping €7.99–15.99 excl. VAT, returns, and Shopify/WooCommerce/Wix/API support. Exact wholesale prices and product shipping are account-gated, and different brands ship separately.
blocker: Muda Cero still needs a reusable roller at <=€3.49 or an exact full-kit shipping quote. Hertwill exact wholesale price + SKU shipping require a free account/login before Finance can model the channel.

BigBuy.note: Spain/EU-oriented dropshipping, API and broad multi-channel catalog; exact full-kit shipping still pending

Spocket.note: Platform supports neutral packaging/branded invoicing and many US/EU suppliers, but SKU-level origin must be verified individually

Hertwill.note: Free plan up to 5 products and 10 orders/month. EU delivery 3–8 business days. Spain standard parcel shipping €7.99–15.99 excl. VAT. Exact wholesale prices and product shipping require login. Different brands ship separately, so bundle consolidation is weaker than one-warehouse sourcing.

finance: Keep the Muda Cero 39.90 EUR gate unchanged: target reusable roller <=3.49 EUR or obtain exact full-kit shipping.

Hertwill merits a zero-subscription 5-SKU margin test once exact wholesale price and Spain shipping are visible.
